The Samsung 990 PRO 2TB was a great upgrade for my PC. Installation was straightforward, the extra storage is immediately useful for games and files, and the system feels fast and responsive in everyday use. It is the kind of upgrade that improves normal tasks as much as it helps with larger workloads.

The 2TB capacity is a comfortable fit for a gaming or work computer, and the PCIe 4.0 design gives compatible systems plenty of performance headroom. Just make sure your motherboard or laptop has a compatible M.2 slot. For speed, capacity, and reliability in my setup, this is an easy 5-star SSD.
